author: OneRing2001
quote: The best possible outcome for a remake of the best game of all time (yes, even with "GTA 6" out, it solo's that easily). You know exactly what your going to get and it's great, yet im still surprised with the graphics, quality of life additions, and the voice acting. Superb game and i honestly enjoyed it more than GTA 6, it lived to up to it's hype.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: OneRing2001
quote: If you look at this from far away, it LOOKS like a better game than GTA 5 and RDD 2, HOWEVER looks can be deceiving. Me being hyped for this game is an understatement, RDD 2 is my top 5 favorite games so I am nowhere near a hater of Rockstar, just wanted to bring this up. The story is slow, too focused on the relationship between the two main characters, and it simply doesnt engage you like the older ones in the series. The game totally lacks in options and choices, you dont feel like you have any impact on the story at all, waaaaaay too many restrictions. the majority of the characters (including our main duo) feels either cringy at points or just lackluster, they dont have enought spice or ANYTHING that makes them stand out. RDD 2 had such a great cast of MEMORABLE characters, GTA V's protagonist's felt so unique and different from each other that brought different aspects to the story! to say im sad with how GTA 6 turned out is putting it lightly, I wished so much more from this and it sadly couldn't stick to the landing.
